I fixed the failing test; all 14 tests in `test/test_YoutubeDL.py` now pass.

The bug was in the format-selector parser in `youtube_dl/YoutubeDL.py`, in `build_format_selector`. When it parsed a `/` choice such as `bestvideo/best`, it added the choice to the list of selectors and cleared the current selector. A following `,`, as in `bestvideo/best,bestaudio`, then added that cleared (`None`) selector to the list. That `None` crashed the build with `AttributeError`.
